# Rafael Mouallem Rosa

I am a **researcher at Inria**, in the Statify team in Grenoble, France. My research is in Bayesian statistics, with applications to statistical learning and macroeconomics.

My current work develops the **Sources of Uncertainty (SoU)** framework for Bayesian inference. SoU allows different components of a statistical model to be assigned different levels of confidence, providing a way to control their probabilistic treatment and how uncertainty is propagated across the model. This flexibility offers a new tool for Bayesian model design.

I explore applications of this framework to sparse estimation and model selection, Bayesian neural networks, and macroeconomic inference. I hold a Ph.D. in Economics from the São Paulo School of Economics (FGV), was a visiting scholar in the Department of Economics at Harvard University, and previously worked in quantitative finance.

## Selected research

**Empowering Bayes with sources of uncertainty: from confidence modelling to sparse estimation**  
Rafael Mouallem Rosa, Julyan Arbel, and Hien Duy Nguyen (2026). Working paper.  
[arXiv (earlier version)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.03134) · [Code](https://github.com/rafmoua/sou-paper)

Introduces the SoU framework, studies its connections to empirical Bayes and profiling, and develops a general approach to sparse estimation, illustrated in regression and Bayesian neural networks.

**SoU-BVARs: Adapting Inference about Macroeconomic Relationships**  
Rafael Mouallem Rosa (2026). Manuscript.

An application of the SoU approach to Bayesian vector autoregressions and the analysis of macroeconomic relationships.

**SoU-RHS: Bayesian Structured Sparsity for Compact Architecture Recovery in CNNs**  
Rafael Mouallem Rosa and Julyan Arbel (2026). Manuscript.

Develops structured Bayesian sparsity at the filter level to recover compact convolutional neural network architectures.
